text:
Anya Park: Quick heads-up- we found a runtime compatibility issue: some clients interleave short HTTP-like prefaces mid-websocket stream and our v4 parser splits NDJSON chunks. Repro attached.
Rajiv Malhotra: Is this new or a variant of last quarter's mixed-framing bug?
Anya Park: Variant. That one was upgrade-handshake related. This is a mid-stream pattern proxies emit, legit traffic for a few clients.
Mei Li: Gateway-side normalizer sounds right. Suggest a lightweight sniff-first translator that only rewrites when pattern matches; avoid touching the fast path.
Lisa Gonzalez: Ops constraints: must be tenant-opt-in, have a clear sunset, and a global kill-switch. Need SLA impact estimate before rollout.
Anya Park: Benchmarks (canary): p50 +4-7%, p95 +10%, p99 +18% under heavy multiplexing. CPU uptick on gateway ~12-18% when translator active.
Mei Li: Implementation notes: sniff first 256 bytes, FSM-based matcher (avoid full regex), LRU fingerprint cache to skip repeated sniffing. Emit header when rewrite applied.
Rajiv Malhotra: Rollout plan sketch: tenant opt-in -> small canary -> phased waves (5%, 25%, 60%) with telemetry gates -> 12-week opt-in grace -> removal with 90-day notice.
Lisa Gonzalez: Telemetry gates should include translator.error-rate, p99 latency regression threshold, and delta 5xx rate. Also set automated email for tenants showing compat events.
Anya Park: Sample gateway snippet: {"route":"/v4/*","compat":{"mode":"framing-cohort-bridge","tenant_allowlist":["t-77","t-99"],"emit_header":true},"rollback_key":"gateway.frag.bridge_disable"}
infra-bot: Canary scheduled: gateway-framing-cohort-canary at 2025-03-03T09:00:00Z (CI#5123). Monitors: gateway.cpu, request.latency.p99, compat.event.rate, translator.error-rate.
Mei Li: I'll build translator as a pluggable module and own perf tuning + LRU cache.
Rajiv Malhotra: I'll pair on flamegraphs and add test harness for mixed preface + NDJSON streams.
Lisa Gonzalez: I'll draft tenant comms and the deprecation timeline.
Anya Park: I'll write the RFC follow-up with rollback criteria and dashboards. Reconvene in 48h. :thumbsup:
